mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 6.0% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as elevated unemployment signals weaker labor market conditions and reduced corporate growth prospects.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 6.0% in the next month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive despite UNRATE crossing above 6.0%, or p-value > 0.05 in t-test comparing returns to baseline in such events.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in federal funds rates above 4.5% and quarterly GDP growth exceeding 2% in the same month amplifies concerns about overheating, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to stronger growth expectations.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and GDPC1 growth > 2% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both triggers are met, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent spikes in CPIAUCSL above 225 and declines in UNRATE below 7.5% in the same month signal strong inflationary pressures paired with labor market tightness, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as markets anticipate robust growth.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises above 225 and UNRATE falls below 7.5% in the same month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both triggers occur, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (GDP) growth above 2% in the prior quarter signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as market optimism about corporate earnings and investment flows intensifies.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous drop in INDPRO below its 2-month average of 94.0 and a rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% in the same month indicate weakening industrial production and tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced growth prospects.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 94.0 and FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive despite both triggers occurring, or p-value > 0.05 in t-test comparing returns to baseline in such events.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle inflationary pressure regime marked by CPIAUCSL exceeding 225, sustained inflationary pressures drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as markets anticipate prolonged growth and higher interest rate expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL exceeds 225 in the regime, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) by over 5% alongside a decline in federal funds rates by more than 1% in the same month signals robust labor market strength and accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >5% and FEDFUNDS decreases by >1% in the same month
regime_hint: labor market expansion and monetary accommodation
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both triggers occur, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-month rolling window.
